text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (December 5, 2023) for 1501 Woodbine Avenue, Unit 708.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (December 5, 2023) for 1501 Woodbine Avenue, Unit 708, Folder Number: 23 231754 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to April 30, 2024.
